prompt: Convert RIKEN lipidomics TSV pair using defaults; output must pass pymzTab-m validation with 0 ERROR messages.

assertions.name: output_file_exists
assertions.description: Output file /tmp/eval_runs/eval-0/output/result.mztab exists and is a non-empty mzTab-M file

assertions.name: in_memory_validation_zero_errors
assertions.description: Reading the output file with pymzTab-m read(format='tsv', auto_complete_ids=True) yields zero MessageType.ERROR messages

assertions.name: has_metadata_section
assertions.description: File contains MTD lines including mzTab-version, mzTab-ID, ms_run, sample, assay, study_variable, cv, database

assertions.name: has_sml_smf_sme_sections
assertions.description: File contains the SMH/SML, SFH/SMF, and SEH/SME table sections

assertions.name: ms_run_count_matches_samples
assertions.description: Number of MTD ms_run entries equals number of non-Blank sample columns from the MTD TSV (default behavior excludes blanks: expect 6)

assertions.name: feature_rows_present
assertions.description: At least 100 SML rows are emitted (the input has ~1237 candidate alignment rows)
